rule: Current Visa, historical Citi and explicit Mastercard facts retain network/version status. Unlisted or historical-only is review-worthy, not proof of source corruption.
Recognize dd.mm.yyyy and dotted settlement dates in Stockport. Original cell text and raw-row fingerprints remain unchanged; dependent analyses are recomputed.
Support N>=20 separately per merchant/source/scheme; event counts across schemes overlap and are not a unique-transaction total. Majority bands: >=.9, [.7,.9), <.7. Report support coverage.

NFKC uppercase; longest configured prefix first; remove 3+-digit runs, store-number patterns and alphanumeric reference tokens; preserve raw merchant. A reference-only Amazon marketplace descriptor retains its marketplace identity.
Do not infer statement dates from heaping; retain unknown when field semantics are unverified.

Exact, normalized, unambiguous observed code-description, unique >=16-character prefix, then fuzzy >=95 with margin >=5; every other candidate remains needs_review. Inferred labels never overwrite source codes.
Supplier payments, zero returns, fees, adjustments, transfers, cash and unknown records stay canonical but are excluded from primary card-only label/purity/coverage analysis.

Purpose-present rows use internal category; purpose-absent rows with category are MCC candidates. Do not impose unverified calendar-year cutoffs. Exact normalized MCC descriptions in supplier field are masked.
Only explicit merchant_aliases.yaml patterns and six supplied source-city suffixes; alias effect counts below; dictionary entries are hypotheses, not verified entity matches.
NFKC uppercase, punctuation/space collapse and AND/& equivalence. Raw spelling is preserved.

USA ambiguous slash dates use month-first, UK use day-first; ISO and typed worksheet dates take precedence; UK-invalid-first alternatives may parse under the other convention. ISO-typed Excel dates are not reinterpreted.
No duplicates removed. All counts are audit statistics; personal-field-excluded exact fingerprints are clearly identified for Oklahoma.
Original strings/dates/amounts remain in original files. Parsed values and keys are separate fields in private canonical/analysis Parquet; no cleaned raw-data release.
Only original files in eleven declared source folders; exclude Indonesia, prior worksheet CSV conversions, folder merges and global merge to avoid repeated counting.
Mask street/number pattern as ADDRESS_REDACTED before storing labels; never print original purpose examples; masked label events excluded from purity.

1000 empirical i.i.d. bootstrap replicates, seed42-derived per identity. Normalize by fixed observed within-merchant label count; clustering, key and temporal dependence uncertainty are outside these intervals.

Debits become negative, credits positive; original Debit Amount and Credit Amount remain in the original workbook. These negative amounts denote bank outflows, not refunds, and are not comparable to a public-source negative/refund rate.
Recognize numeric serials 20000-60000; Excel origin 1899-12-30. Other outlier dates remain visible, not corrected.

Unlabelled, internal-only, distinct source/descriptor strings with >=20 within-source merchant support and identifier/address screening; deterministic source/group/length/prefix round-robin; unequal inclusion, no prevalence claim.
Drop Last Name, First Initial and Cardholder Name at reader projection; do not persist any identifier list. Raw-row duplicate fingerprint excludes those personal fields.
